description: Full SEO technical audit of a single web page URL. Fetches the page server-side plus the origin's robots.txt and sitemap, and runs 13 weighted checks: robots.txt present, robots not blocking the page, no noindex directive, sitemap present and valid, title tag length, meta description length, canonical tag, viewport (mobile), H1 structure, Open Graph completeness, JSON-LD structured data, image alt coverage, and a fetch-performance signal. These are the technical failures that make a page invisible in search — a robots-blocked or noindexed page cannot rank at all, and a missing sitemap, title, or canonical quietly caps the rest. Returns machine-readable JSON: 0-100 score, A-F grade, a search-visibility risk level (Low/Moderate/Elevated/High) with the blocking checks named as triggers, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, a page block (status, bytes, fetch time, title, sitemap URL), and the top 3 prioritized fixes. HONEST LIMITS: this is a single-page snapshot — it does not crawl the site, and it uses no keyword, ranking, backlink, or Search Console data; no audit can guarantee ranking. Cost: $1.00 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this after a redesign or template change, before a launch, or to triage a sudden traffic drop.
